title: MedMira Inc
description: Founded in 1993, MedMira is the developer and owner of Rapid Vertical Flow (RVF) Technology. The test applications are built on RVF Technology provide hospitals, labs, clinics, and individuals with instant diagnosis for diseases such as HIV and hepatitis C in just three easy steps.
